name: SOLD AS SEEN: Interactive ESL Mystery
description_short: An interactive choose-your-path mystery for B1–B2 learners (about ages 12–14), for screens: students read, choose between two options at each decision point and find one of seven endings (112 routes). A British used-car dealership, October 1986. About 45 minutes. PDF, 30 pages, $4.99 on Payhip.
